title: The Dark Knight
plot: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.
writer: Jonathan Nolan, Christopher Nolan, David S. Goyer
actors: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart

title: Jurassic World
plot: A new theme park, built on the original site of Jurassic Park, creates a genetically modified hybrid dinosaur, the Indominus Rex, which escapes containment and goes on a killing spree.
writer: Rick Jaffa, Amanda Silver, Colin Trevorrow
actors: Chris Pratt, Bryce Dallas Howard, Irrfan Khan

title: Jurassic Park
plot: An industrialist invites some experts to visit his theme park of cloned dinosaurs. After a power failure, the creatures run loose, putting everyone's lives, including his grandchildren's, in danger.
actors: Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum

title: Teen Beach Movie
plot: Two surfing lovers, whose doomed relationship is nearing to a close, find themselves swept into a dimension-traversing wave that sends them into a beach movie musical in the 60's.
writer: Vince Marcello, Mark Landry, Robert Horn
actors: Ross Lynch, Maia Mitchell, Gracie Gillam

title: Hannah Montana
plot: Adventures of a teenage pop star who keeps her identity secret from even her closest friends by using a disguise on-stage.
writer: Richard Correll, Barry O'Brien, Michael Poryes
actors: Miley Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles
awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 21 wins & 28 nominations total

title: Wizards of Waverly Place
plot: The Russo family may be an ordinary family with an average restaurant, but behind closed doors, all three children must compete to be the next family wizard.
actors: Selena Gomez, David Henrie, Jake T. Austin
awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 49 wins & 68 nominations total

title: Interstellar
plot: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain
